Perform an in-depth architectural and code quality review:
1. Audit for strict type safety (TypeScript, Pydantic), defensive error handling, and clean modular boundaries.
2. Verify performance metrics (P99 latency, caching, bundle size, database indexing).
3. Validate alignment with executive-grade impact (ROI, cloud SLA, compliance).
4. Return categorized findings (Critical, High, Medium, Value-add recommendations).
